SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_ADD_WORDS_LAYER_HINT: The image is generated without any text, then you type the headline over it. This keeps the words sharp and spelled correctly.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_NO_LOGO_YET: No logo saved for this organization yet.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_NO_LOGO_ADMIN: No logo saved for this organization yet. An administrator can add one on the branding page.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_NO_LOGO_LOCKED: No logo saved for this organization yet. Branding changes are turned off.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_NO_ORG_ZONE: This domain has no organization zone, so a logo cannot be saved
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_STYLE_REFERENCE_HINT: Attach one picture to set the look and feel. Its colors, mood and composition guide the artwork without appearing in it.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.IMAGE_GEN_USE_BRANDING_HINT: The organization's colors, font and tone shape the image, and its palette is offered for the words. Turn it off for a poster that is not meant to look like us.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.BRAND_COLOUR_INVALID: A brand color must be a hex value like #0E6E52.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.BRAND_HINT: Used whenever artwork is generated for this organization, so posters come back in your colors rather than the model's.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.BRAND_LOGO_HINT: Upload one and the other version is made from it, keeping your colors. Replace either with your own file whenever you have one.
SIGNAGE_MANAGER.BRAND_READ_ONLY: Branding is set for the whole organization, so only an administrator can change it.
